title: [iOS] What's your IAP (In-App Purchase) strategy?
author: Appropriate-Value610
selftext:
Hey everyone,

I'm a solo dev working nights and weekends on **Mad Snake**, a fast-paced arcade snake game for iOS with modern twists (inspired by the classic Nokia 3310 Snake).

I launched about 3 weeks ago and I'm seeing some solid traction: people are downloading and actively playing daily.

I've set up AdMob (rewarded + interstitial ads) and that's working well. I also created a couple of IAPs: "Buy Extra Lives" and "Remove Ads". Right now I show both options when players die (they get 3 retries) or at Game Over, but not many players are tapping on them.

I'm trying to figure out the ideal game flow for surfacing IAPs to actually increase conversions.

How would you approach this? What's worked for you?

comments.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
comments.body: Call me crazy but I don't think a game of snake needs in app purchases. Maybe just polish more and charge for the game?
